What some decisions force

Source: R/configuration.R
vp_consequences.Rd

What some decisions force. Selecting a feature selects what it requires and leaves out what it excludes; leaving a feature out leaves out what requires it and selects what it is joined to in the at-least-one graph.

Usage

vp_consequences(model, selected = character(0), deselected = character(0))

Arguments

model

A model, from vp_generate() or vp_read(), in its complete or its minimal form.

selected

Features that the product must have.

deselected

Features that the product must not have.

Value

A tibble with feature, value ("selected" or "left out") and forced_by (the decision that forces it, written as "A" for "A selected" and "not A" for "A left out"; a decision you gave is forced by itself).

See also

Other configuration: vp_can_go_together(), vp_count_graph_products(), vp_kernel(), vp_kernel_links(), vp_mig(), vp_most_decisive(), vp_pair(), vp_partial_configuration(), vp_rounds(), vp_split_after(), vp_splitting_decisions(), vp_team_links(), vp_team_moves(), vp_team_order(), vp_teams()

Examples

band <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3.uvl"), or_graph = TRUE)
vp_consequences(band, selected = "TouchScreen")
#> # A tibble: 9 × 3
#>   feature         value    forced_by  
#>   <chr>           <chr>    <chr>      
#> 1 TouchScreen     selected TouchScreen
#> 2 Screen          selected TouchScreen
#> 3 OLED            selected TouchScreen
#> 4 CapacityButton  selected TouchScreen
#> 5 HeartRateSensor selected TouchScreen
#> 6 BLEv42          selected TouchScreen
#> 7 MovementFilter  left out TouchScreen
#> 8 BLEv40          left out TouchScreen
#> 9 BT40            left out TouchScreen
